description: ARERA, Italy's regulator for energy, networks and environment, publishes an interactive comparison of the contractual quality of the integrated water service. ARERA produced it to show the service levels delivered by the water operators, summarised by the macro-indicators MC1 (start and end of the contract) and MC2 (management of the contract and access to the service), defined by resolution 547/2019/R/idr for the incentive scheme of rewards and penalties of the RQSII, and the contractual quality standards each operator has committed to, with a focus on standards above the regulatory minimum. Coverage is the operators of the integrated water service in Italy, queryable by region, municipality, operator or performance class. It is free to view on the ARERA site; no licence or download is stated. Caveats: it covers customer-facing contractual performance, not technical quality such as leakage or outages, and the page does not state the years shown. Simulation uses: operator-level service performance as a baseline for resilience comparisons of Italian water utilities. Related records: the Czech water utility benchmarking (data-czech-mze-water-utility-benchmarking-vak).
